title: meta
description: Bundle-level metadata (meta.json). Identity, bake configuration, provenance and summary statistics for one published book. See DESIGN §4.3.

bundle_version.description: Schema/version generation of this bundle. v1 bundles are always 1; the field exists so future bundle formats can be distinguished and migrated (DESIGN §4).

book_id.description: Permanent book identifier. Gutenberg books are 'pg-{gutenberg_id}'; user-supplied books are 'usr-{first 12 hex of sha256 of normalized source text}' (DESIGN §4.1). Ids never change and are never reused.

revision.description: Monotonic revision counter, starting at 1 on first publish. Bumped whenever an additive revision (re-selection or plate re-render) changes the bundle (DESIGN §4.4).

title.description: Human-readable book title. From the source adapter, overridable in bake config.

author.description: Author name as a display string. May be empty for anonymous/unknown works but the field is always present.

language.description: Primary language of the text as a short code (e.g. 'en'). Advisory; feeds transforms and reader typography.

source.description: Where the text came from, for provenance and offline re-bake.

kind.description: Origin class of the bundle text. 'gutenberg' = fetched from Project Gutenberg via Gutendex; 'user' = uploaded/pasted/markdown sideload (DESIGN §5.3). Distinct from the admin API request 'kind' (gutenberg|text|markdown), which is not stored here.

gutenberg_id.description: Project Gutenberg book number. Present only when kind = 'gutenberg'.

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the source text was retrieved/ingested.

era.description: Historical/aesthetic era for the book (e.g. '1890s England'). Set in bake config (human), defaulted from an admin-UI guess. Feeds the transform prompts (DESIGN §4.3).

style_id.description: Id of the illustration style used for this bake, referencing an entry in styles.json (DESIGN §9), or the sentinel 'custom' for a free-text look (ADR-0031). Not enum-locked because styles are data, not schema.

custom_style.description: The owner's free-text look for the 'custom' style (e.g. 'photorealistic'; ADR-0031), or null for a catalog style. Pinned so re-renders and art-set re-rolls reproduce it. Absent on bundles published before ADR-0031.

density_preset.description: Plate-density preset used for selection (DESIGN §8). One of the three v1 presets.

images_per_scene.description: Illustration-richness dial (DESIGN §8). Tightens the selection engine's page spacing so a higher value selects proportionally more distinct pages, one picture each, spread evenly across the whole book. 1 = the preset's default spacing (byte-identical to a single-picture bake). Optional/absent means 1. (Prior meaning: N clustered pictures per scene page — retired in ADR-0016.)

portraits_enabled.description: Whether dramatis-personae portraits were rendered for major characters in this bake (DESIGN §10).

bake.description: Provenance of the bake that produced this bundle: when, against which services/models, at which pipeline version. Pins everything needed to reproduce or audit generation (DESIGN §4.3, ADR-0003).

completed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the bake (publish) completed.

transform_service.description: The text-transform-service instance and transform versions used.

url_host.description: Host (and optionally port) of the text-transform-service that served this bake.

transforms.description: Map of transform name (e.g. 'scene-update', 'cast-mentions') to the exact version string reported by the service at bake time. Keys are transform names; values are version strings.

additionalProperties.description: Version string of one transform, as reported by the service.

models.description: Model identifiers as reported by the GPU services at bake time.

llm.description: LLM model tag used for text transforms (e.g. 'qwen3:8b'), as reported by the transform service.

imagegen.description: Image-generation model tag used for rendering (e.g. an SDXL variant), as reported by the imagegen service.

pipeline_version.description: Version of the scriptorium pipeline that produced this bundle (e.g. a 'git describe' string).

stats.description: Summary counts for the published bundle, for display and sanity checks.

pages.description: Total number of logical pages in the bundle.

words.description: Total word count across all pages.

plates.description: Number of rendered plates (illustrations) in the bundle, excluding cover and portraits.

chapters.description: Number of chapters detected/used in the bundle.
